market_question: Will the No to ten million Switzerland initiative be approved in Switzerland’s June 14, 2026 popular vote?
reasoning: The initiative's population cap would directly violate EU free movement pacts, a red line for Swiss voters who rejected a similar limitation initiative in 2020 by a wide margin (~62% No). Strong cross-party and business opposition, combined with the double‑majority requirement, makes approval very unlikely; market‑implied 33.5% significantly overrates its chances.
evidence_points: 2020 ‘limitation initiative’ (similar EU‑treaty‑threatening anti‑immigration measure) failed with only 38.3% Yes.
Constitutional amendments in Switzerland require a double majority (voters + cantons), historically a high bar.
Federal Council, parliament, and major business unions all recommend rejection; no broad coalition supports it.
sources_consulted: Knowledge of Swiss referendum history (2014 mass immigration, 2020 limitation initiative)
Swiss Federal Chancellery and vote documentation structure
